## Download

Download **`CV-Manager-*-arm64.dmg`** below, open it and drag **CV Manager** to Applications.

Requires a Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 11 Big Sur or later.

## The first time you open it

CV Manager is not notarized by Apple yet, so macOS asks for your permission once:

1. Open the app. macOS says it can't verify it is free of malware; close the alert.
2. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway** next to the message about “CV Manager”.

Or, from Terminal: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/CV Manager.app"`

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the checksum of the `.dmg`.
